    ("What is Bridge?", "the wood transmitting string vibration"),
    ("What is Intonation?", "tapes or a teacher’s ear guide finger placement"),
    ("State one governing principle of violin basics.", "Straight bows and relaxed hands first."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    print(f"A{i}: {a}")
    score += 1
print(f"Quiz complete: reviewed {score} of {len(qa)} key points.")
